details.description: Enhanced Meeting is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Enhanced tier, marked beta, tuned for conference room settings with multiple speakers captured by a single microphone. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists the Enhanced tier, together with Nova 1 and Base, under "Legacy Models," and supports enhanced-meeting for English only.
advantages: Deepgram documents it as "optimized for conference room settings, which include multiple speakers with a single microphone."
Deepgram describes Enhanced-tier models as generally having "higher accuracy and better word recognition than our base models," and handling uncommon words "significantly better."
disadvantages: Deepgram marks enhanced-meeting as a beta model on its Model Options page.
Deepgram lists the Enhanced tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview.
Supports English only (en, en-US), per Deepgram's language documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing multi-speaker conference-room recordings captured on a single microphone.

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to enhanced-meeting were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Deepgram's Model Options page marks enhanced-meeting as beta; its Models & Languages Overview separately groups Enhanced (with Nova 1 and Base) under a 'Legacy Models' heading. The catalog carries no deprecation_date.
